A cue decides only when it clearly singles out one option over every other; a weak cue, or one another option shares, decides nothing. Otherwise answer 'none'. Say which cue decided it, or that none did.

recorded.prompt:q-and-then:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-and-then:a: add_bool_or means "at least one literal is true", not the if-then rule.
recorded.prompt:q-and-then:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-and-then:b: add_bool_and means "every literal is true", which forces all three to be funded.
recorded.prompt:q-and-then:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-and-then:d: add_implication(a, b) is "if a then b", so these say s implies f1 and f2, the reverse direction.
recorded.prompt:q-two-literals:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-two-literals:b: "Two copies of the row, one enforced by each literal, would mean something else ... whenever either project is funded."
recorded.prompt:q-two-literals:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-two-literals:c: only_enforce_if takes literals, and "A literal is a Boolean variable x, or its negation ~x"; a - b is not one.
recorded.prompt:q-two-literals:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-two-literals:d: "only_enforce_if(l1, l2, ...)"; "Passing two literals means both"; "No M to compute".
recorded.prompt:q-bonus-side:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-bonus-side:a: That pattern let "The first model claim the rebate with only $2,260k of vegetation work".
recorded.prompt:q-bonus-side:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-bonus-side:b: "No solver status catches a half-reification written on the wrong side"; the objective pushes the bonus Boolean true.
recorded.prompt:q-bonus-side:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-bonus-side:c: The honest side is "rebate implies more than" the threshold. c makes b imply capex at most 3000, the reverse.
